text:
The image appears rotated: a white perforated optical-style breadboard/panel fills the frame, with a grey wall or surface along the right edge.

Across the middle lies a black rectangular rack or holder mounted between aluminium extrusion profile rails, with visible end-face T-slot cross sections at the left. The rack has a row of circular openings: about five dark, empty-looking round holes/recesses in a line, then a light grey capped vial or cylinder, and at the end an orange cap or disc.

Above, a white square-plate device with a dark knob or connector sits, with a black cable running from it to the top of the frame, plus a small black block.

Lower left: a white tray/plate. Lower right: a curved pale grey housing.
